title: One Spot Left
subtitle: Sarvgun & Elahi, Episode 1
moral: Lesson learned: teammates beat rivals. There was only one spot on the sign-up sheet, but there was always room for two sisters on the same team.

scenes.title: Star of the House
scenes.action: Sarvgun runs her dance routine in the living room, clean and confident. Elahi watches from the doorway, arms crossed, unconvinced.

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: Five, six, seven, eight, and that's how it's done.

lines.speaker: elahi
lines.text: Cool. I'm gonna do something way cooler.

scenes.title: The Sign-Up Sheet
scenes.action: School hallway. The talent show sheet has exactly one slot left in their category. Both sisters lunge for the pen at once.

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: One spot left. Whoever's ready first by Friday gets it.

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: That's mine!

lines.speaker: elahi
lines.text: That's mine!

scenes.title: Turf War
scenes.action: Masking tape splits the living room into two practice zones. Their parents have clearly seen this movie before.

lines.speaker: elahi
lines.text: Your side ends at the couch.

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: The couch is my side.

scenes.title: Rival Prep Montage
scenes.action: Sarvgun drills the same eight counts until they're perfect. Elahi builds a magic act out of kitchen props: a disappearing spoon, a levitating toy with very visible string.

scenes.title: Accidental Sabotage
scenes.action: Elahi's rabbit puppet gets borrowed as a hairbrush. In return, her make-it-disappear trick actually deletes Sarvgun's rehearsal playlist.

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: Where is my playlist?!

lines.speaker: elahi
lines.text: Ta-da? I didn't mean for real, for real.

scenes.title: The Big Blowout
scenes.action: One day left. Sarvgun still has no music. Elahi still has no working trick. Neither one will admit it, and it comes out sideways.

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: This is your fault. If you weren't so loud about entering, I would not be panicking right now.

lines.speaker: elahi
lines.text: My fault? You are the one who would not just share the spot!

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: Because it is my act, Elahi, not yours!

lines.speaker: elahi
lines.text: Fine! I wish I had a different sister!

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: Fine! Have the whole house, I do not even care!

acts.title: The Turn
acts.subtitle: midnight, living room, no more tape

scenes.title: Sorry, In the Dark
scenes.action: Midnight. Both sneak downstairs to practice alone, still upset, and collide in the dark instead.

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: Ow. Sorry, I did not see you there.

lines.speaker: elahi
lines.text: Me neither. I am sorry too. About earlier.

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: I did not mean what I said. I do not actually want a different sister.

lines.speaker: elahi
lines.text: I do not want a different sister either. You are my favorite one there is.

scenes.title: The Idea
scenes.action: Elahi fumbles a trick, and it lands right on the beat Sarvgun is humming. A beat of silence. Then both talk at once.

lines.speaker: elahi
lines.text: Wait. Do that hum again.

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: Elahi, that's actually good.

scenes.title: One Act, Two Sisters
scenes.action: Friday morning. Instead of competing for the one slot, they ask to enter together, a dance routine built around Elahi's illusions.

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: A duo act? I like it.

scenes.title: Curtain Call
scenes.action: The mashup act is a little chaotic and completely charming. The crowd loves it. Mid-bow, an old argument reignites right on schedule.

lines.speaker: sarvgun
lines.text: I'll bow first, I'm older.

lines.speaker: elahi
lines.text: I'm smaller, so I bow lower. It's just math.
